scene: A secret transport pass clatters from the chute onto the floor.
picture: Flat side view along the tiled concourse. On the far left stands a cylindrical glass karaoke elevator with open doors. Left of centre, the silver-haired boy in a mint-green hoodie holds a freshly dropped transit pass beside the arcade exit. At centre rests an open light-rail pod. On the far right, a hover ferry floats.
shown: a tubular glass elevator door glowing pink on the far left
a sleek silver light-rail pod waiting open at the platform centre
a blue river hover ferry idling at the water dock far right
